item.title: n8n workflow automation
item.description: N8n is an open-source workflow automation tool that enables users to connect various applications and services through a visual interface. It supports a wide range of integrations, including AI services, allowing users to create complex workflows that leverage artificial intelligence for tasks such as data processing, content generation, and decision-making.
